prompt:
def remove_first(xs, v):
    """return a new list without the first occurrence of v"""
reference:
out = list(xs)
    if v in out:
        out.remove(v)
    return out
tests:
assert remove_first([1, 2, 3, 2], 2) == [1, 3, 2]
assert remove_first([1], 9) == [1]
assert remove_first([], 1) == []
